title: Rip off
body: I paid for this and it never worked. I even reached out to the company and haven’t heard anything back about a refund or at least help with my account. If there were a zero star option I’d have picked that…

title: Comical Subscription Fee
body: $500!? HA. I thought it was a joke at first. No one will ever pay that for access to making your own party games. What are we doing here.

title: Way too expensive to effectively use the app
body: It was a good idea but to use the main features (i.e. have more than 5 questions) they want to charge you $500 for a yearly subscription. Their cheapest option is $75 for 2wks. That is absolutely beyond unjustified and y’all know it. Who in their right mind would pay that much for something that a novice game developer could make? Cut the cost by 90% and you would have more buyers, this makes no sense as a business model and is insulting to your users.

title: Ridiculous
body: First off, in order to add more than three sets you have to pay. I was only going to use this once and I don’t mind paying. I look at the prices and it blew me away. 75-1,000 dollars???? Are you serious? The concept of family feud is easy, that being said it’s pretty easy-moderate to program. I can’t understand why they would charge SUCH a high price for a game.
